proposed.text: A floor plate has 320 sqm total window opening area and 3,200 sqm floor area. What source-safe PD 1096 daylighting conclusion follows?

options.text: The window-opening area equals 10% of floor area, satisfying the PD 1096 Section 808 minimum for rooms not served by artificial ventilation; verify ventilation separately
It fails daylighting because 20% is always required
It satisfies a separate 5% ventilation rule without any further source check
It is irrelevant because daylighting is never regulated

proposed.rationale: PD 1096 Section 808 supports the 10% window-opening minimum. The proposed edit removes the separate unsupported ventilation-ratio conclusion.
proposed.explanation: 320 / 3,200 = 10%, so the PD 1096 window-opening minimum is met for the stated daylighting condition. Ventilation must be checked under the applicable ventilation provision, not inferred from this calculation alone.
